Team —

We need a quick sweep of all Q2 committed/opportunity-stage deals ahead of the leadership pack. Please do the following by EOD Wednesday (Mar 3):

- Confirm stage owner in the "Stage Owner" column of the shared sheet (link below).
- Upload one-line evidence for each commit (what proof we'll show in the exec pack: signed PO, procurement email, legal redline agreement, completed security questionnaire).
- Flag any deals where we expect a late-stage change (price/discount >10%, contract-term risk, or pending procurement approval).

I've attached a small template to standardize evidence entries (pipeline_evidence_template.xlsx) and added a sample row for RDW-2387 (Acme Analytics). Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cD3eF4-ghI

Why this matters: leadership wants a clean QBR pack with a one-slide summary per commit + backup evidence. If we don't get consistent inputs, the pack prep takes extra cycles and increases exec follow-ups.

If you have questions on formatting, ping Jonas; if you need procurement notes or external contact details for a given deal, loop me in.

Thanks —
